summary: 1. No tenant on a record and no principal-identity endpoint. LOAD-BEARING: the union's ceiling for a KEYED caller is therefore not narrower than the store's, and the entitlement label says so rather than simulating one. Owning tenant and caller tenant are both a one-way sha256 handle over the presented credential (sf-principal:<16 hex>), so they match records the store served to that caller and no others. The anonymous determination remains fully independent.

2. No originating publishing authority on a document version. RECORD class obligates citing the publisher; the adapter cites the custodian ('Smart Files') plus the exact fetch, and does NOT print SEC or CME on a record whose publisher the store never stated.

3. Neither the file listing nor the file read carries byteSize, which the contract requires. Adapter reads content-length off the blob and cancels the body: one extra round trip per document per room read. store.mjs already writes byte_size at upload.
4. GET /files/:entityId is a catch-all, so /files/<id>/content answers HTTP 200 with status 'not-sought' instead of 404. The adapter never probes, so it is not bitten; the next consumer will be.

5. The store speaks a parallel absence vocabulary (status 'not-sought', a bare basis, no verdict/authority/scope/timestamp). The adapter translates rather than passes through, which is correct, but the two vocabularies should be reconciled on purpose.

blocked.why: The twin envelope requires node shape, asset class, display name and at least one identifier, and only the security master can state them. It cannot for this node: GET /securities/current-symbol/sec_01JCZK8QW9V4T6XH2NBGRPY5MD returns {node_id, symbol: null}, and GET /securities/canonical/{node_id} echoes ANY well-formed identifier back including sec_00000000000000000000000000, so it is not an existence check. The E2E node exists as an identifier, not as a described node.
blocked.whatWasDoneInstead: The room got its own address at GET /v0.1/room/:nodeId and the get_instrument_room MCP tool, through the same composeRoom gate. Fabricating a shape to have something to render would fabricate the single fact every layer keys off.
